scope: synthetic CPU tests, NAP DFM CPU probe, and isolated DFM skinned GPU readback
coverage: face-list tangent basis and preserved DFM attributes
selected second UV channel and handedness
triangle-strip alternating winding and degenerate connectors
independent corner tangents across mirrored UV seams
finite orthogonal fallback for degenerate UVs
orthogonal fallback for near-normal-parallel Mikk tangents
invalid indices, counts, channels, non-finite UVs and oversized groups
limits: The GPU probe used the production Basic_Skinned vertex shader and DfmTangentVertex with a diagnostic fragment shader; it did not exercise BasicMaterial, CommandBuffer, transparent sorting, a real DFM asset or a NAP snapshot.

gpu_probe.gpu: Mesa Intel HD Graphics 4600, OpenGL 4.6 Mesa 23.2.1
